scope: Synthetic adversarial validator probes only; no live evidence, device, simulation, or publisher copying.

results.name: gate_cards_omit_contract_required_fields
results.reason: A status and receipt string substitute for all required scene, geometry, schedule, qualification-scope and calibration fields.

results.name: whole_paper_without_scientific_conditions_or_phase_evidence
results.reason: 31 arbitrary condition labels and summary booleans substitute for all source material/layout/temperature conditions, phases, controls, allocated specimens and ancestor evidence.

results.name: replicate_count_not_enforced_by_campaign
results.reason: A seven-replicate plan is accepted with one cell summary and no sample IDs.

results.name: forty_cycles_reuse_four_receipts
results.reason: Forty cycle indices do not establish forty distinct program/release/recovery/integrity occurrences; same four receipts are replayed.

results.name: program_substitution_after_verification
results.reason: A completed phase can claim a different program from the verified job.

results.name: unsafe_state_reappears_at_unload
results.reason: safe_to_unload earlier is accepted despite explicit unsafe readbacks on unloaded event.

results.name: impossible_timestamp
results.reason: ISO-shaped but impossible date passes regex-only validation.

results.name: duplicate_card_hides_missing_model_card
results.reason: Card count equals gate count but duplicate unknown_id leaves one gate with no resolution schema.

results.name: missing_transport_route_count
results.reason: Removing a route does not fail declared STATUS transport_route_count=18 or full inventory consistency.
